Spider-Man: Brand New Day is swinging back into theatres this December and, now, we know it's coming bundled with an Avengers: Doomsday bonus. As per The New York Times, Brand New Day's re-release comes included with a deleted scene from Doomsday to help set up the multiversal crossover. Already, Marvel has deployed Avengers: Doomsday teases in various movies, shows, and marketing spots. The Avengers: Endgame re-release featured Hulk on Doctor Doom's radar, while the VisionQuest post-credits scene saw Latveria's ruler resurrect Scarlet Witch from underneath the Darkhold Castle. Now, it seems the most successful non-Avengers superhero movie in history is going to do the same trick – and it could potentially link into a Brand New Day post-credits scene that spotlighted the webhead on the Spidey-Tracker, before seemingly showing him being teleported to outer space, complete with some now-trademark Doom static effects. Spider-Man: Brand New Day's second run in theatres – arriving for a limited time from December 4 – will also include more scenes and "surprises." One of the confirmed additions is a deleted scene featuring Tom Holland's Peter Parker and Rosario Dawson's Claire Temple, reprising her role from Netflix's street-level Defenders shows. No word yet on if Tom Holland will appear in Avengers: Doomsday, though new actors are being included all the time – such as Hailee Steinfeld, who is back as Kate Bishop and even showed up in the final Doomsday trailer released earlier this week. titre: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Rerelease Includes a Scene Cut From Avengers: Doomsday
chapo: Spider-Man: Brand New Day rerelease includes a scene cut from Avengers: Doomsday, according to a new report.
extrait: Spider-Man: Brand New Day rerelease includes a scene cut from Avengers: Doomsday, according to a new report. The New York Times published an article on the potential for the release of Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part 3 — dubbed DunesDay by fans — to set box office records, and within it is a tease for the extra footage set to be included in Spider-Man: Brand New Day’s return to theaters. According to the NYT, Spider-Man: Brand New Day will have a scene cut from Doomsday added to the end of the movie as a bonus. We don’t know what’s in the scene, but it’s meant to serve as an ad for the upcoming MCU film. Spider-Man: Brand New Day made an eye-watering $2.5 billion at the global box office, so I assume you've seen it. If so, has the promise of a new Avengers: Doomsday scene convinced you to double-dip? Let us know in the comments! What we know for sure is that Rosario Dawson will return as Claire Temple in the rerelease, marking her long-awaited comeback to the MCU. Last week, Dawson revealed a photo of her in costume for her first Marvel appearance in a decade, standing in nurse scrubs next to Tom Holland's Spider-Man. It's a scene that fans thought they'd never get to see after it was deleted from the final cut of the movie. Now, however, it is being reinstated for the film's extended edition rerelease, entitled Spider-Man: [Brand New] Brand New Day, alongside a handful of other moments previously left on the cutting room floor. It's pretty obvious when this scene will take place, as Dawson's character stands next to Tom Holland's Spider-Man who is wearing a hospital gown and his Spidey mask. Of course, Spider-Man finds himself in hospital towards the end of the movie, and Dawson's return will likely answer fan questions surrounding how the superhero got patched up with no one else discovering his identity. (The answer, surely, is that Dawson takes care of him directly — having been used to keeping numerous superhero identities secret in the past.) Spider-Man: Brand New Day returns to theaters on December 4, 2026, now with Rosario Dawson and an Avengers: Doomsday cut scene included. Avengers: Doomsday itself launches on December 18.
